title: Read summaries, page deliberately, then select full detail
when: A QA plan catalog, session roster or steering report is large
need: QA and session lists serve 25-row summary pages; QA plan --full adds detail to the same page and never returns the whole catalog, and the web Test plans view loads one page per project with Load more. JSON chooses format and obeys the same 28,000-byte CLI bound. A refused read prints no partial answer and names narrowing or --full. Steering JSON computes complete facts; --json --full permits the full reply. Hook and watcher digests compose alarm inputs and return compact disappearance identities.
surface: CLI help, command results and refusals
